pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular sub-polygonal and lobed geometries with soft edge gradients likely exacerbated by low sensor resolution and motion blur. Dark contiguous regions show a significant decrease in relative spatial area from the mid-flank toward the posterior and tail base.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Lattice-like negative space network with high connectivity. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial. Pixel thickness of the pathways is non-uniform, showing greater width on the mid-flank and narrowing as the network converges toward the hindquarters.
